title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go + parity & version bumps
author: Maya Lin
description: Summary: This PR harmonizes auth retry semantics and streaming API ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, fixes several parity gaps, and bumps package versions. Motivation: customer and internal signals (ENG-372) showed inconsistent client behavior after token refresh/backoff on transient 401s and streaming reconnects. The goal is to provide the same retry/backoff primitives, streaming reconnect hooks, and default timeouts across all SDKs so application behavior is predictable when running against Redwood hosted, dedicated, or private deployments. Changes include: 1) unified auth retry strategy: centralize token-refresh detection + single configurable RetryPolicy (exponential backoff w/ jitter, max attempts, retryable status codes), 2) streaming ergonomics: introduce reconnect() callback and incremental resume token semantics (where supported) and stabilize stream iterator semantics, 3) parity fixes: align method names and error types across languages, add missing metadata headers for telemetry parity, 4) version bumps: Python 1.5.0 -> 1.6.0, TS 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0, Go v0.9.0 -> v0.10.0, 5) tests & docs: add cross-language integration tests and update changelogs/README examples. Compatibility notes: defaults are backwards-compatible; advanced users can opt into legacy behavior via explicit RetryPolicy=legacy. Linear/Jira: ENG-372, PM-88, SUP-1143. Checklist: [x] implement shared retry primitives in each SDK; [x] streaming reconnect API and examples; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] update changelogs and bump package.json/go.mod/setup.py; [x] CI green across all SDK job matrices. See commits for per-language breakdown.
commits: python: add RetryPolicy class + token refresh hooks; update client stream iterator and tests
typescript: unify retry/backoff implementation, add reconnect callback to streaming client
go: expose RetryPolicy type and resume token logic for streaming; update examples

test: add cross-sdk integration test harness and CI matrix updates

Ravi Shah: TS changes look good; minor nits on JSDoc and example verbosity. Also observed intermittent e2e failure in streaming matrix on the first CI run.
Maya Lin (author): Addressed docs nits and sequentialized the streaming integration job to mitigate flakiness. Added a retry wrapper in CI for flaky network tests.
Clara Ng: Go API looks idiomatic; please add a short doc comment about ResumeToken semantics and backward compatibility.
